evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/e implements Callable<V>, wraps exactly one Callable<V>, invokes it in call(), logs 'Uncaught exception in callable {}' on Throwable and rethrows.
The static helper returns a new wrapper for an arbitrary Callable and is consumed by rs/A/h before executor submission.
RuneLite CallableExceptionLogger has the same generic Callable wrapper, static wrap helper, logger string and rethrow behavior.
Exact v308 rs/A/h implements ScheduledExecutorService and delegates to one wrapped ScheduledExecutorService.
submit/execute paths wrap Runnable through rs/A/r and Callable through rs/A/e before delegation, while lifecycle/invoke/schedule methods delegate to the backing service.
RuneLite ExecutorServiceExceptionLogger implements the same ScheduledExecutorService decorator around RunnableExceptionLogger and CallableExceptionLogger.
Exact v308 rs/A/r implements Runnable, wraps exactly one Runnable, invokes it in run(), logs 'Uncaught exception in runnable {}' on Throwable and rethrows.
The static helper returns a new wrapper for arbitrary Runnable instances and is consumed by rs/A/h before execute/submit delegation.
RuneLite RunnableExceptionLogger has the same Runnable wrapper, static wrap helper, logger string and rethrow behavior.
